contract.intent: Make the shaping phase a real, proportionate product: the phase that turns an idea into a validated, grounded plan is named and built out as shaping. Depth is decided by the grill (small clear ideas skip the vision), and the interactive session gathers enough with a paced, human experience. This leg turns the decided shaping model into working flow + tests and documents the phase so the look-back reads it as part of how ann operates.
acceptanceCriteria: Shaping is the name of the idea-to-plan phase wherever the flow is described; spec names only the final document
Depth is conditional: the grill decides whether the vision runs; a small/clear solid idea reaches a light spec without a vision (tested)
The full path still exists for ambiguous ideas: vision then spec (tested)
The grill session gathers the depth signal and open questions in a bounded, batched dialogue; the human never re-authors a prior artifact
ann check and verify hold at the accepted baselines and the leg is managed through ann with rationale at its gates
expectedOutputs: conditional shaping chain (vision optional by grill)
shaping naming reconciled across flow data + docs
